issue.title: test_same_body_in_different_projects_does_not_coalesce fails since 00badb84e: _digest_project ignores catalog-unknown projects
issue.description:
Found by the sase-171 land agent at master 983965361 (escalated full test-scoped lane, then reproduced in isolation on a pristine tree).

`tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_tribe_prompts.py::test_same_body_in_different_projects_does_not_coalesce` fails with `assert 1 == 2`: two members whose prompts are `#gh:alpha\n<body>` and `#gh:beta\n<body>` coalesce into one TribePromptGroup and `multi_project` is False.

Root cause: 00badb84e (sase-16n.11.7.4, "warm rebuild of tag surfaces, pager accents, tribe PROMPTS chip") rewrote `_digest_project` in `src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/prompt_panel/_agent_tribe_prompts.py` so only catalog-known targets count (D5): it returns None for unknown names or when `peek_project_tag_catalog()` is cold. The test's `alpha`/`beta` are not in any seeded catalog, so both prompts get project None and share a group key. The test passes at 00badb84e^ (verified in a detached worktree). That commit updated test_agent_display_tribe_prompts.py but not this test.

Fix: seed/pin a project-tag catalog containing alpha and beta in this test (as f456a8b3b did for bead launch tests), or otherwise align the test with the D5 known-target rule. Do not revert D5.
